item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE and LEMMY KILMISTER’s Deaths Share Chilling Parallel and Bizarre Coincidence
item.description: Lemmy Kilmister and Ozzy Osbourne had long careers, larger-than-life personalities, and music that shaped generations. But they also share something much more unexpected, both rock icons died exactly 17 days after their final performances.
